title: Deadly measles spread hitting US state's Amish hard amid White House row
paragraphs: The US state of Pennsylvania is grappling with its worst measles outbreak in three decades, with more than 1,300 cases reported since April.
Amish communities have been directly impacted due to low vaccination rates, leading to the deaths of six people.
The outbreak is the largest of multiple outbreaks across the US, happening amid an uproar over Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr's controversial vaccine stance.
